body:
subject: #1958 merged (BUG-1236 Completed) — thank you; #1959 round 1 on TASK-1285; rebuild note

#1958 merged at 22:36, BUG-1236 Completed and ledgered. Good fix: returned failures, one retry, state on the marker, list --fix, label at detection under the BUG-1180 classification. Once the next binary is built, drive PRs carry the label without a hand step. The one asymmetry left — a hand-applied label with NO marker still needs `aida merge-hold clear` before aida pr ship can pass the gate (I hit it on #1946 and on #1958 itself) — is filed as a low drain-safe follow-up so ship treats label-only as a releasable hold.

#1959 (TASK-1285): round 1 CHANGES REQUESTED on the spec. The rebuild refusal and the AFTER_WAVE park are right; the blocker is binary_change_conflicts returning true for every activation, so `aida dev activate` would be refused in every shell while a wave is live — activation only edits a shell's PATH. Activation must never be refused; keep the guard on the build path only.

Rebuild sequencing: main now carries #1946 (schedule registry), #1949, #1958. TASK-1285's guard is not on main yet, so the rule stays manual: rebuild only when the lock is free (it is, if 0918h has drained), then relaunch. Still at my gate awaiting rework: #1956 (BUG-1244, CI red + scope), #1957 (TASK-1284, liveness fallback), #1959 (TASK-1285, activation refusal).
